scope: Independent source and disposable-regression review of the scratch22 admission/materialization adapter. This is not a preparation execution release, prepared-artifact acceptance, build release or runtime acceptance.

original_findings.family: scratch22 preparation usability and actual receipt interfaces
original_findings.finding: The initial adapter permanently refused execution and provided only read-only admission, leaving no executable scratch22 materialization path after cleanup/source prerequisites.
original_findings.resolution: Dispatcher authorized one bounded correction. --materialize now requires a fresh exact independently reviewed preparation release, then reaches the inherited preparation implementation with execute=true and all arguments explicitly bound. Default admission remains read-only.

original_findings.family: scratch22 preparation usability and actual receipt interfaces
original_findings.finding: The initial status=PASS/scope=scratch21-cleanup normalized receipt assumption was incompatible with the actual cleanup transaction outputs and did not join its terminal evidence chain.
original_findings.resolution: The cleanup producer and adapter authors coordinated actual scratch21.cleanup-result.v1 output with unchanged PASS_EXECUTED/PASS_TERMINAL_REPLAY statuses. The adapter consumes that exact terminal result, canonical executed release and plan, complete nine-event journal, retained capture/archive identities, and exact independent cleanup postflight joins. No normalized receipt is required.

checks: Fresh candidate/manifest/request/output/evidence/lease/log/terminal names use scratch22. Only the canonical owner exclusion ABI slot deliberately remains scratch18; no scratch21 request or materialization is reused.

Every default parameter of inherited prepare is explicitly supplied, including target/old/baseline/source_base/exact_delta and image/IHK/overlay authority constants. Signature comparison refuses a newly unbound inherited default; scratch19's frozen-default failure is covered.
The released target owner is parsed and must expose the exact scratch18 exclusion slot before inherited preparation. The scratch20 mismatch family remains fail-closed.

All 486 unchanged large evidence inputs are required across scratch15/16/17/18/20/21. Alias roots and nested paths are canonical, every authenticated path has the same complete snapshot, Git blob/mode matches, and nlink equals the number of distinct retained roots. Unknown links and replaced/symlink aliases refuse. The production count is census-derived; the next link count is derived from it.

Exact target commit/tree/parent/baseline, origin fetched ref and released A/M path/blob delta are checked. The actual RS-011 author record's five ordered successful checks and twelve relative file identities match the source consumer contract; each is bound to its target Git blob and the independent review's author-record/file-hash joins.

The actual cleanup producer's result schema, terminal statuses, plan layout, archive tuple ordering and hash-chained journal fields match validate_cleanup. DRAFT or validation-only output, incomplete chain, changed capture, missing postflight or release mismatch cannot supply cleanup authority.

Materialization requires exact adapter/test/ancestor hashes matching controller Git blobs plus an independent preparation execution review with different author/reviewer, no implementation ownership, exact target/tree and prerequisite hashes. A source-only release cannot select materialization.

Immediately before inherited materialization, the adapter checks scratch canonical path/device/current boot/ext4 UUID/rw-nodev-nosuid profile and capacity floors. The inherited implementation rechecks all destinations and measured full storage requirements; real live authority remains a later execution-release responsibility.

The inherited execute path constructs private target Git metadata and exact blobs, authenticates IHK/overlay/image receipt inputs, invokes the actual candidate manifest and driver.verify_inputs, and invokes actual BuildOwner.validate. The adapter revalidates the returned request, enforcing non-executable preparation flags and no Docker construction.
Original failed test and original source-review findings remain recorded. No oracle, production acceptance count or scratch21 consumed authority was weakened or transferred.
execution_prerequisites: Accepted actual scratch21 cleanup execution and independent exact postflight; all original cleanup evidence remains preserved.
Accepted independent RS-011/source-authority review and dispatcher commit/push/fetch verification of the selected target/tree/parent/delta and preparation controller sources.

Fresh exact scratch22 preparation execution release with actual prerequisite record paths/hashes, independent preparation execution review and fresh live binding; this review does not supply that release.
After materialization, independently review the actual prepared artifact and issue the separately required one-shot build release.
